texts: mixed: the conditional itself is right — neither the large store nor the tending is asserted outright — but two labels come out wrong: "the Keepers", capitalized like a proper name, is recorded as a group of keepers with the name dropped, and "Sunken Cove" is left with nothing recording that it is a cove. Lower-casing the role word fixes the first: "When the feather store at the Watch is large, the keepers tend the Sunken Cove lanterns safely in winter." The missing cove typing is a translator-side omission your wording cannot prevent.
good. all the participants are covered — the Council, the rations, the Sunken-Cove station as recipient, winter as the time — with the station linked to the named Cove rather than fused into it.
good. judged faithful on review: a fireable conditional asserting neither a small store nor growing risk, with "feather store" and "wraith risk" each recorded as a kind of store and of risk.
